C-LAND-AGENT-TOOLING-FROM-BRANCH.Summary: Land the agent tooling stranded on chore/agent-config-and-theme — the Dart MCP server registration and the flutter-run skill — onto main, adapted so every harness used with this repository can follow it, then delete the branch.
C-LAND-AGENT-TOOLING-FROM-BRANCH.Problem: chore/agent-config-and-theme had its PR (#2) merged on 2026-08-13T14:02Z, but three commits landed on the branch around that merge and never got a PR of their own: 4252313 registers the Dart MCP server (.mcp.json plus enabledMcpjsonServers in .claude/settings.json), 0e53a3d adds a 151-line flutter-run skill, and 803228c is a local-only commit that was never even pushed. None of that content is on main: .mcp.json is absent, .agents/skills/flutter-run/ is absent, and the 'Live app inspection (Dart MCP server)' section is absent from AGENTS.md. The skill itself names the problem in its last paragraph — it is only on the branch that introduced it, so every other branch is missing the setup and the file. It is the only copy: nothing equivalent exists outside the repository.

Goals.Goal: Put the Dart MCP registration on main so every branch and every harness inherits it: .mcp.json at the repository root plus the Claude Code opt-in in .claude/settings.json.
Land the flutter-run skill where this repository's agents actually read skills — .agents/skills/flutter-run/SKILL.md — without losing any of the operational knowledge it carries.
Adapt the skill's tool references to every harness in use here, with the plain-CLI path as the universal floor that works with no MCP at all.
Bring the live-app-inspection guidance into the current AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, which were rewritten for GRACE 4 and no longer contain it.
Only then delete the branch, so the rescue is what makes the deletion safe.

Constraints.Constraint: The skill must keep its harness-independent content verbatim in substance: the SIGUSR1/SIGUSR2 CLI loop, the JSON-RPC probe of dart mcp-server, the 21-tool inventory, the traps (plain path not file://, boot devices first, pass udid, hot reload resets scroll and navigation, swipe-from-card, python3 -u) and the app-specific layout knowledge (nav bar overlay needing ~110 pt, DailyRacesDisplay is a content block, cards carry no fixed size).

Tool names must be verifiable in this workspace, not invented: DSH exposes the server as dart-mcp-server (hot_reload, hot_restart, get_runtime_errors, widget_inspector, pub, dtd) and device screenshots through the ios_sim tools; Claude Code reaches the same server as its dart MCP entry.
No application code changes: the diff must touch only .mcp.json, .claude/settings.json, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the new skill file.
JSON files must stay valid JSON, and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md must stay byte-identical to each other, as the repository keeps them mirrored.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No change to the graph's module list: M-WIDGET-CAR-DEALER and friends describe the app, while this is repository tooling. The change names M-AGENT-TOOLING as its affected area and records that it is an area, not a graph module.

The branch's commit history is not cherry-picked; the content is landed in an adapted form, so main..chore/agent-config-and-theme will still list three commits after this change. That is expected and is recorded in the commit message.
No DSH profile edits: registering the server in ~/.dsh is a separate operation that requires the app to be closed.
The repo's other agent directories (.opencode, .mimosa, .zcode and similar) are untouched.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: .mcp.json exists at the repository root, is valid JSON, and registers a dart server that runs `dart mcp-server`.
.claude/settings.json still parses as JSON and carries "dart" in enabledMcpjsonServers.
.agents/skills/flutter-run/SKILL.md exists with frontmatter name: flutter-run and a description naming when to use it.
The skill names the CLI fallback with SIGUSR1/SIGUSR2, the JSON-RPC probe, and the harness-specific routes for Claude Code and DSH.
AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md both carry the live-app-inspection section and remain identical to each other.
No file outside the declared write scope changes: git diff --name-only lists only the five expected paths.
The chore/agent-config-and-theme branch exists on neither the local repository nor origin after the change.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: python3 -c 'json.load(open(".mcp.json"))' ; python3 -c 'json.load(open(".claude/settings.json"))' ; head -3 .agents/skills/flutter-run/SKILL.md ; diff -q AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md ; git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACM $(git rev-parse HEAD)
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Both JSON files parse, the skill opens with name: flutter-run, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are identical, and the changed-path list contains only .mcp.json, .claude/settings.json, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the skill.

Assumptions.Assumption: The branch's skill content is still accurate; the August timings and traps are presented as measured then, and the tool-name route is what needed updating, not the knowledge.
One copy of the skill in .agents/skills/ is enough: that is the directory this repository's agent sessions read, and the user chose not to mirror it into .claude/skills/.
Deleting the branch is safe only after this change lands, which is why the deletion is the last task rather than a preliminary.
